purpose: A pure BM25 control over cs_v1_control. It exists to exercise the frozen split and the evaluation harness and to establish the preregistered local comparator for a future SYSTEM-H paired run.
is_not: eligible to inherit any SYSTEM-H claim, hash or preregistration

implementation.scoring: Postgres tsvector match with BM25 length normalisation; IDF ln(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5))
implementation.tie_break: round(score,9) DESC, then chunk_id ASC — deterministic and re-runnable
implementation.randomness: none — no seed is required anywhere in this system
